title: Stopping Times in the Filtration of a Brownian Motion Stopped at its Last Passage Time
summary: We investigate the structural properties of the last passage time $σ_z^λ$ at level $z > 0$ of a Brownian motion with positive drift $λ> 0$, denoted $B^λ = (B_t + λt)_{t \geq 0}$, in the filtration generated by the process $ξ^{λ,z} = (B^λ_{t \wedge σ_z^λ})_{t \geq 0}$. We compute the compensator of $σ_z^λ$ and establish that it is the unique totally inaccessible stopping time in the filtration of $ξ^{λ,z}$.
